items.title: Decoding DoD cybersecurity: CMMC, DFARS, and FedRAMP Equivalence demystified
items.summary: Whether you’re a prime contractor, a subcontractor deep in the supply chain, a managed service provider (MSP) supporting DIB clients, or a CSP hosting defense workloads, this post explains what’s required, who’s responsible, and how to build a compliance strategy that holds up under scrutiny. Because nearly every one of these pathways ultimately runs on cloud infrastructure, we also highlight where Amazon Web Services (AWS) and AWS GovCloud (US) fit. The foundation you build on shapes how achievable compliance becomes.
items.creator: Tim Sandage

items.title: Decoding DoD cybersecurity: Compliance guide for DIB organizations
items.summary: Defense industrial base (DIB) organizations working through Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), and Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) requirements struggle to know how to get started. The answer depends on your role in the defense supply chain and the type of information you handle.
items.creator: Tim Sandage
